Assessment Paused - Screen Sharing Stopped or Not Available

Your assessment has been paused because screen sharing has stopped or is not available.

This may be because:
  • Screen sharing was stopped or cancelled.
  • Screen sharing permission was not allowed.
  • The required screen or display is no longer being shared.
  • Your browser or device settings are preventing screen sharing.
Continuous screen sharing is required during the assessment. The assessment cannot continue
until screen sharing is restored.

Don't worry - your assessment progress has been saved.
DETAILS.EScreenBlankFramesHowToProceed:
Please check the following before relaunching:

  1. Allow screen sharing when prompted.
  2. Make sure the required screen or display is selected for sharing.
  3. Check that the necessary browser and device permissions are enabled.
  4. Ensure screen sharing remains active throughout the assessment.
  5. Click Relaunch when ready.
  6. If you are still unable to proceed, please contact the assessment administrator immediately.
Once screen sharing is active, you can continue with your assessment.
DETAILS.EBlankFrames:
Assessment Paused - Camera or Microphone Not Detected

Your assessment has been paused because we cannot detect your camera or microphone.

This may be because:
  • Your camera or microphone permissions are blocked.
  • Your camera or microphone is disconnected.
  • Another application is using your camera or microphone.
  • The lighting is too poor for the camera to see you clearly.
  • Your internet connection is unstable.
Don't worry - your progress has been saved.
DETAILS.EBlankFramesHowToProceed:
Please check the following before relaunching:

  1. Allow camera and microphone access in your browser and device settings.
  2. Check your camera and microphone are connected and working.
  3. Close any other apps using your camera or microphone.
  4. Sit in a well-lit area so your face is clearly visible.
  5. Check that your internet connection is stable.
  6. Click Relaunch when ready.
  7. Check you can see yourself clearly in the camera preview.
Once everything is working, you can continue your assessment.
